item.title: R
item.description: For my master's thesis, I am utilizing an ARDL-PMG model to analyze panel data of European countries in order to differentiate between short- and long-term effects. I am currently coding my model in R, but I can not find any resources on the internet that can guide me in setting up my model in RStudio; I only see resources that utilize EViews or Stata. I am not very savvy when it comes to coding. Does someone perhaps know of a website or forum where there are instructions as to how to code an ARDL-PMG model within RStudio?
